tests.name: build-info answers JSON (the runner confirms the verified commit from it)

tests.reason: POST /api/v1/internal/health-erasure/member-residue deletes and rewrites rows (user_connections tokens, connector_webhooks_log, partner_health_result_inbox) in the database staging shares with production, and on staging it answers 409 STAGING_READ_ONLY by design before any database call; staging suites send only GETs. The webhook-log user_id is set only on a signature-verified vendor webhook, which a read-only suite cannot send. Both suites mock every database call and prove auth (401/403), the 400 and 409 guards, the three erasure parts with residual re-selects, complete semantics, the OASIS payloads (no tokens, raw_payload or member id), the single mount and the atlas claim, and the user_id rule on the success and the three failure log sites.
